name: Antivirus / update issue
description: Checks Defender service and pending reboot; third-party antivirus and signature freshness remain unverified.

rules.cause: Microsoft Defender service is stopped. Another managed antivirus may be installed.

actions.label: Recommended next steps
actions.instructions: Verify the organization's antivirus product, protection state and signature timestamp in its management console. Do not enable or disable security services automatically.
